limitations: B078 produced no confirmed new scientific fits and did not establish full-season model superiority or promotion.

Owner B079 execution, actual scientific fit concurrency, fresh current-season scores and forecasts remain unverified until a new authenticated owner return.

observed_runtime.cpu_qualification: Time-weighted observed process CPU across matched native heartbeat intervals; excludes unobserved intervals and is not whole-instance utilization.
observed_runtime.reservation_qualification: Most preflight reserved one core; a brief 12 then 11 core transport lease is not observed parallel scientific training.

publication.qualification: This evidence file records prepared source. Exact commit, required checks and merge are verified separately through GitHub; hosted browser tests are not website deployment.

implemented_repairs: Isolate baseline measurement ownership and use the owning graph frame cache; retain both directory integrity guards.
Keep bounded authenticated manifest and file-pin caches; reuse unchanged model and checkpoint bodies without removing recipe, clock, commit or SHA-256 checks.
Keep heartbeat identity fields separate from payload metadata; bind the active process by invocation, boot identity, process ID and process start time.
Capture child stdout and stderr, preserve append-only per-invocation human logs and JSONL telemetry, and periodically flush status independently of training progress.
Detect stalled progress with process-tree and stack diagnostics; preserve failed child exit codes and recoverable checkpoints.
Request bounded resources for real independent work and report measured CPU separately from reservation and scientific fit concurrency.
verification_summary: Recovery: 13 local regression tests passed, including the exact two-context failure chain, warm zero-rehash reuse and tampered model/clock rejection.
Supervision: 9 local tests passed with real operating-system children, silent-stall stack capture, exit-7 preservation and append across restarts.

Shared logging: 18 regression tests passed, including a real child-registration log-write failure. Source-pinned blocked and failed child executions lasted 33.055 seconds overall; maximum measured heartbeat gaps were 10.016 and 10.016 seconds, with four and three tail-F observations while the respective children were alive.
Fixture validation does not count as real NBA fitting or establish owner-host twelve-core training throughput.

The exact replacement package passed all 338 packaged tests in 42.052 seconds, with zero failures, errors, skips or module errors. All 1,113 members were read back and SHA-256 verified; all 1,077 original B078 members were preserved. The tests include 18 shared logger regressions and 11 launcher process fixtures, with zero real NBA fits.
